goal:
T50 — Arena EvoForge lane with Critic feedback (v3.6 §2.2 fair comparison; builds on T47 + T48). Today the
EvoForge lane retries with the names of failing held-out tests (an oracle signal). Add a mode where it retries using
only the independent Critic's own tests, exactly like run_pipeline(feedback="critic") from T47.

- POST /v1/arena accepts feedback: "heldout" | "critic" (default "heldout"; anything else -> 422). Budget guard counts
  one extra Critic call for the EvoForge lane in critic mode.
- In critic mode the EvoForge lane: one spec-first Critic call (sealed_eval._call_critic_suite with
  sealed_eval._critic_goal_for_task) before the first attempt, then attempts whose retry goal comes ONLY from Critic
  failures (sealed_eval._critic_feedback / _critic_empty_feedback / _critic_apply_failed_feedback); the sealed held-out
  suite scores the judged attempt (the first one passing all Critic tests, else the last) and never enters feedback.
  Reuse T47 helpers; do not duplicate their logic. The Critic call's cost is part of the lane's cost_cents. Emit lane
  events with role "critic" (Critic wrote N tests; attempt k: Critic m/N passed).
- Manifest (T48): lanes.evoforge.feedback = "critic" in critic mode ("heldout_failing_test_names" otherwise), and the
  disclosure sentence matches the mode (critic mode: the EvoForge lane gets no held-out signal; it adds a Critic call;
  Runner compute not included). Store feedback on the arena document.
- Single lane, scoring, verdict, previews (T49) unchanged.
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t50.py.
